div.div:
Rust shell
[app/src-tauri: Tauri commands]
Validates every UI argument, then asks the service through the ServiceClient trait. Runs one subscription thread (events.rs) that forwards pushed events to the UI and tray and shows notifications. Also: credential store, Gitea API client, diagnostics bundle, service install, Pitcrew updater.

div.div:
Pitcrew service
[pitcrew-service: Rust]
One supervisor thread owns every runner; an async IPC server answers the app; worker threads do downloads, swaps and cleanups. Asks the login shell for the runners' PATH and restarts itself when its program changes.
